limitations: Publisher's protected model answers, full original pictures, partner card files and original applets not verified.
First-party text-alternative examples authored; no authenticated renderer or persisted student teacher workflow was checked.
Information gap and learner-created geometric/ratio designs require human rubrics; numeric answer checks only support narrow deterministic subskills.
